findings.title: Extracted createWorkingDir duplicates existing resolveWorkingDir helper
findings.why_it_matters: The directory that startup creates and the directory each backup run later deletes with os.RemoveAll are computed by two separate copies of the same GIT_WORKING_DIR-or-default rule, so a future change to one copy (trimming, GetEnvOrFile support, a different default name) silently makes soba create one path and clean up another. This refactor lifts the inline copy out of Run() into a new named helper, createWorkingDir, but keeps the copy instead of calling resolveWorkingDir(backupDir), which already lives in the same file and is what runProviderBackups uses. Calling it is a behaviour-identical one-line substitution (both return the env value when non-empty, else filepath.Join(backupDir, workingDIRName)) and leaves a single definition of the rule.
findings.suggested_fix: In createWorkingDir (internal/backup.go:473-478) replace the four-line os.Getenv/if/filepath.Join block and its comment with `workingDIR := resolveWorkingDir(backupDIR)`; keep the log line and MkdirAll unchanged. Output is identical for every input, so the log line and created path do not change.
evidence: internal/backup.go:52,57 -- workingDir := resolveWorkingDir(backupDir) ... defer cleanupWorkingDir(workingDir, backupDir)  (the cleanup side uses the canonical helper; the create side does not)

provenance: function wrapper createWorkingDir is new in 136a4850 (line 473); the wrapped body lines 474-478 date from 476ed841 and resolveWorkingDir from 6adadb6b (Jon Hadfield 2026-06-24), i.e. the duplication pre-dates this change and the refactor re-housed it in a new helper rather than removing it

residual_risks: Intent check ("log output unchanged"): collectProviderBackupResults now evaluates `bitbucketAPITokenDefined() || bitbucketOAuthDefined()` (internal/backup.go:101) with short-circuit, where the base read all five BitBucket variables unconditionally. GetEnvOrFile logs "file ... does not exist" / "error opening file" for an unreadable *_FILE path (internal/envfile.go:36-38), so with complete API-token credentials plus a BITBUCKET_USER/KEY/SECRET_FILE pointing at a missing file, that diagnostic line is no longer emitted from each backup run. Narrow misconfiguration-only difference; not verified by execution.

displayBitBucketStartupConfig now uses strings.EqualFold via the shared logProviderCompareMethod where the base used strings.ToLower(compare) == compareTypeRefs (internal/backup.go:219,282). These differ only for non-ASCII fold characters (e.g. U+017F), so the logged compare method is the same for any realistic value.
testing_gaps: No offline test asserts the startup-config log lines. displayStartupConfig was rewritten from five inline blocks into label/env-var parameterised helpers (logProviderOrgs, logProviderBackupsToKeep, logProviderCompareMethod, logProviderBackupLFS) that deliberately preserve irregular strings ("Gitlab backup LFS" vs "GitLab ...", "Organistations"); the only execution of this path is via Run() in credential-gated tests that skipped in the baseline run. A table test that sets env vars, swaps `logger` for a buffer and compares output would pin the stated "log output unchanged" contract.

checkProvider's partial-credential path (now checkUserAndPasswordProvider / checkJustTokenProvider) and backupStatusTitle have no direct tests; the only checkProvidersDefined test is TestCheckProvidersFailureWhenNoneDefined (internal/backup_test.go:787), which exercises the zero-provider case only.
